name: vibecode
description: AI-assisted development with the developer at the wheel: options and diffs before every change, closed slices, scoped allowances, intent-to-behavior review before commit.

interface.shortDescription: Engine for the agent, wheel for the developer
interface.longDescription: Understand the repository, surface every technical decision with options and a diff, implement one closed slice at a time, honor scoped allowances, and validate intent against behavior before commit.
defaultPrompt: Use $vibecode to understand this repository before we change anything.
Use $vibecode: show me the options for this change before implementing.
Use $review-i2b to validate this slice from intent to behavior.
